The Search for JouleOS

Today's operating systems schedule clock slices, not energy—so we mapped what an agent machine must require and tested its core rules in Rust.

[310 Passing Rust Tests · 78,400 Provenance Checks]

1/3 Modern computers stack many separate software layers, and today's AI agents are bolted on top without changing the floor underneath.

2/3 None of those underlying layers asks, before an agent acts, how much energy the action will spend or whether it fits.

3/3 A machine built for agents must meter energy honestly, grant strict budgets, and refuse any action that breaks its limit.

Energy class: unmetered (Verified Software + Model; joules=null, never faked as zero).
